title: Card number not in XREF is rejected with reason 100
condition: WHEN branch: the keyed XREF read for DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM 4000000000000099 returns INVALID KEY. XREF holds only 4000000000000001.
expectation: Failure reason is set to 100 with 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'. The account lookup and checks are skipped. The transaction is not posted: reject count is 1 and one reject record is written. ACCOUNT 1 and TCATBAL stay unchanged (balance 500.00).

title: Control: card found in XREF, transaction posted
condition: Opposite branch: the XREF read finds 4000000000000001, so the reason stays 0. The account checks pass: 0 - 0 + 125.50 is within the 5000.00 limit, and expiry 2030-12-31 is after the transaction date 2024-03-15.
expectation: Reason stays 0 and the transaction is posted. Reject count is 0 and no reject record is written. ACCOUNT 1 and the TCATBAL for 1/01/0001 each rise by 125.50.

title: Near-miss card numbers (last digit off, truncated to 15 chars) are rejected
condition: Key-match boundary for the full 16-character key. One card differs from the XREF card only in the last digit. The other is a 15-character prefix padded with a space.
expectation: Neither transaction matches, so both get reason 100 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'. Reject count is 2, two reject records are written and nothing is posted. ACCOUNT 1 and TCATBAL stay unchanged.

title: Mixed batch: failure reason resets for each transaction
condition: Given clause: the reason is reset to 0 before each transaction. The batch is valid card, then unknown card 5100000000000077, then a different valid card mapped to account 2.
expectation: Transaction 1 is posted to account 1 (+40.00). Transaction 2 is rejected with reason 100. Transaction 3 has its reason reset to 0 and is posted to account 2 (+60.00); it does not inherit reason 100. Reject count is 1 and exactly one reject record is written.

title: Blank card with over-limit amount and late date: reason 100 wins
condition: Override check. The card number is all spaces, so it is not in XREF. The amount (999999.99) and the date (2035-01-01, after every expiry date) would also fail the account checks if those checks ran.
expectation: Reason is 100 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'. It is not replaced by an account-not-found, over-limit or expired reason, because the account steps are skipped when the reason is not 0. Reject count is 1 and nothing is posted.

values.value: Blank card, huge amount, late date

title: Card in XREF but its account is missing from ACCOUNT
condition: WHEN branch: the card is found (reason still 0), and the keyed read of ACCOUNT with XREF-ACCT-ID 10000000099 gets INVALID KEY. A different account (10000000001) is in the file, so the file is not empty.
expectation: Reason 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'. Reject count goes up by 1 and a reject record is written for TRN0000000000001. Nothing is posted. Account 10000000001 and its TCATBAL record stay the same.
warnings: DALYTRAN[0] card's account 10000000099 not in ACCOUNT

title: Control: card and account both exist, transaction is valid
condition: NOT INVALID KEY branch: the account is found and the credit-limit and expiration checks pass (100.00 - 50.00 + 125.50 = 175.50 <= 5000.00, and expiry 2027-12-31 >= 2024-03-15).
expectation: No 101 reject and a reject count of 0. The transaction is posted: account balance and cycle credit go up by 125.50, and TCATBAL 10000000002/01/0001 becomes 325.50.

title: Missing account wins over overlimit and expired conditions; neighbouring account IDs exist
condition: Then clause 2 and a key boundary: XREF-ACCT-ID 10000000004 is missing, but 10000000003 and 10000000005 (one below and one above) are in the file. The amount 999999999.99 and an ORIG-TS of 2099-12-31 would fail the credit-limit (102) and expiration (103) checks if they ran against either neighbour.
expectation: Reason must be 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND', not 102 or 103, because those checks are skipped. One reject is written. No account record or TCATBAL record changes, and the neighbouring account must not be used by mistake.

values.value: OVERLIMIT AND EXPIRED BUT ACCOUNT MISSING

warnings: DALYTRAN[0] card's account 10000000004 not in ACCOUNT

title: Mixed batch: valid, missing-account (negative amount), valid again
condition: A 101 reject sits between two valid transactions on an existing account. The rejected one has a negative amount (-40.00) to show the 101 path does not depend on the amount's sign. This checks that the reason resets for each transaction and the count adds up correctly.
expectation: TRN0000000000004 and TRN0000000000006 post to account 10000000006: balance 300.00 becomes 355.25 and TCATBAL becomes 355.25. TRN0000000000005 is rejected with 101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'. Final reject count is 1 and transaction count is 3.
warnings: DALYTRAN[1] card's account 10000000007 not in ACCOUNT

title: Given not met: card not in XREF, so the account lookup does not run
condition: Precondition boundary: the reason is not 0 after the XREF lookup (card 4111111111110009 is not in XREF), so the rule's account read is skipped.
expectation: Rejected with reason 100 (card not found), not 101. One reject. Account 10000000008 and its TCATBAL record stay the same.

title: Purchase well under the credit limit is posted
condition: Pass branch: credit limit 1000.00 is not less than projected balance 0.00 - 0.00 + 500.00 = 500.00
expectation: No reason 102. The transaction is posted: it is written to the transaction output, ACCT-CURR-BAL becomes 500.00, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT becomes 500.00 and TRAN-CAT-BAL becomes 500.00. Nothing is rejected.

title: Projected balance exactly equal to the credit limit passes
condition: Boundary: projected balance 300.00 - 100.00 + 800.00 = 1000.00 equals the credit limit of 1000.00. The check uses 'less than', so this is not overlimit.
expectation: No reason 102. The transaction is posted: ACCT-CURR-BAL goes from 200.00 to 1000.00, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT goes from 300.00 to 1100.00 and TRAN-CAT-BAL goes from 200.00 to 1000.00.

title: One cent over the credit limit is rejected with reason 102
condition: Boundary +0.01: projected balance 300.00 - 100.00 + 800.01 = 1000.01 is more than the credit limit of 1000.00
expectation: The transaction is rejected with reason 102 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'. It is written to the reject file and not posted, so ACCT-CURR-BAL (200.00), the cycle fields and TRAN-CAT-BAL (200.00) stay the same. The program should end with a non-zero return code because there is a reject.

title: Projected balance of 1,000,000,000 or more loses its high-order digit and passes
condition: Truncation boundary: 1000000000.00 - 0.00 + 500.00 = 1000000500.00 does not fit the 9-integer-digit field. Stored without ON SIZE ERROR it becomes 500.00, which is not more than the 1000.00 limit.
expectation: The original COBOL keeps 500.00 as the projected balance, so the transaction passes and is posted: ACCT-CURR-CBL becomes 500.00 and ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT becomes 1000000500.00. A port that does not drop the high-order digit would wrongly reject it with reason 102, so this case shows that difference.

title: A posted purchase raises the cycle credit, so a second purchase on the same account goes over
condition: Two transactions on one account with a 1000.00 limit. The first gives 0 + 600.00 = 600.00 and passes. After it is posted, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT is 600.00, so the second gives 600.00 + 500.00 = 1100.00, which is more than 1000.00.
expectation: T000000000000005 is posted, making ACCT-CURR-BAL 600.00, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT 600.00 and TRAN-CAT-BAL 600.00. T000000000000006 is rejected with reason 102 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION', and the account and category balances stay at 600.00.

title: A negative amount (payment) brings an over-limit cycle back under the limit
condition: Negative amount: the cycle credit of 1200.00 is already over the 1000.00 limit, but 1200.00 - 0.00 + (-250.00) = 950.00 is under it
expectation: No reason 102. The payment is posted: ACCT-CURR-BAL goes from 1200.00 to 950.00, ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT becomes -250.00 because negative amounts go to the debit field, and TRAN-CAT-BAL becomes -250.00.

title: Transaction on the expiration date is accepted
condition: Boundary: the expiration date (2025-06-30) equals the first 10 characters of DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (2025-06-30-23.59.59.000000). Within the credit limit: 1000.00 - 500.00 + 100.00 = 600.00 <= 5000.00.
expectation: No rejection because an equal date passes. The transaction is posted to the transaction output, account 1's balance and cycle credit go up by 100.00, and the TCATBAL record for 1/01/0001 goes up by 100.00 to 350.00.

title: Transaction the day after expiration is rejected with 103
condition: Boundary: the expiration date (2025-06-30) is one day earlier than the origination date (2025-07-01). Within the credit limit, so only the expiration check fails.
expectation: The transaction is rejected with reason 103 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'. Nothing is posted, and account 2 and its TCATBAL record stay the same.

title: Over limit and expired: 103 overwrites 102
expectation: The transaction is rejected with reason 103 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION', not 102, because the expiration check runs last and overwrites the reason. Nothing is posted.

title: Over limit but not expired keeps reason 102
condition: Control case for the override. Over the limit by one cent (5000.01 > 5000.00). The origination date equals the expiration date (2025-06-30), so the expiration check passes and does not touch the reason.
expectation: The transaction is rejected with reason 102 (over limit). Reason 103 must not appear. Nothing is posted.

title: Before expiration posts, after a year boundary rejects (same account)
condition: Two transactions on one account that expires 2025-12-31. The first originates 2025-06-29 (before expiration, passes). The second originates 2026-01-01, the day after expiration across a year boundary, so the character comparison makes it fail. Both are within the credit limit.
expectation: The first transaction is posted: the account balance goes up by 100.00 and the TCATBAL record goes up by 100.00 to 350.00. The second is rejected with reason 103. Its credit-limit check sees the updated cycle credit (1100 - 500 + 100 = 700 <= 5000), so only the expiration check fails.

title: Single valid transaction is posted, nothing rejected
condition: Reason code stays 0 (posting branch only). The reject count stays 0, so the return code is not set to 4.
expectation: Transaction T000000000000001 is posted. The TCATBAL balance for account 10000000001/01/0001 goes from 200.00 to 325.50, the account is updated and a transaction record is written. The rejects file is empty. The counts print as processed 1 and rejected 0, and the return code stays 0.

title: Unknown card number is rejected with reason 100
condition: Reason code is not 0 because the card is missing from XREF (deliberate warning). This is the reject branch, and the return code becomes 4.
expectation: There is no posting. One 430-byte reject record is written: the 350-byte daily record unchanged, then reason 0100 and the description 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND' padded to 76 characters. The counts print as processed 1 and rejected 1, and the return code is 4. The account and TCATBAL stay unchanged.

title: Mixed run: one posted, one over limit by one cent and rejected
condition: Both branches in one run. The reason code is reset to 0 for each record. The second transaction pushes the cycle balance one cent over the credit limit (reason 102).
expectation: T000000000000003 (100.00) is posted. T000000000000004 (5000.01) is rejected with reason 0102 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION', and its reject record holds the original daily record unchanged. The counts print as processed 2 and rejected 1, and the return code is 4. Only the first amount reaches TCATBAL and the account.

title: Two rejects with different reasons: expired account and missing account
condition: The reject count is incremented once per rejected record, with a different reason code in each trailer: 103 for an account expired before the transaction date, and 101 for a card whose account is missing (deliberate warning).
expectation: No postings. Two reject records are written in input order. The first has reason 0103 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'. The second has reason 0101 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND', and its trailer shows that the reason and description were reset and not carried over. The counts print as processed 2 and rejected 2, and the return code is 4.
warnings: DALYTRAN[1] card's account 10000000004 not in ACCOUNT

title: Boundary: exactly at credit limit and on expiration date is posted
condition: Reason code stays 0 at both boundaries: the cycle credit of 500.00 plus 4500.00 equals the credit limit of 5000.00, and the transaction date equals ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE (2027-12-31). There is no TCATBAL record, so posting creates one.
expectation: The transaction is posted, not rejected. A new TCATBAL record is created for 10000000005/01/0001 with a balance of 4500.00. The rejects file is empty, the counts print as processed 1 and rejected 0, and the return code stays 0.

title: No category balance record: new record created with the transaction amount
condition: Create branch: the transaction passes validation and no TCATBAL record exists for key (acct 12345, type 01, cat 0001), so WS-CREATE-TRANCAT-REC becomes 'Y'.
expectation: A new TCATBAL record should be written with TRANCAT-ACCT-ID 00000012345, TRANCAT-TYPE-CD '01', TRANCAT-CD 0001 and TRAN-CAT-BAL 125.50 (0 + 125.50). The rest of the record should be blank or zero because the record is initialised first.

title: Existing category balance: positive amount added, other category left alone
condition: Update branch: a TCATBAL record exists for (12345, 01, 0001), so the create flag stays 'N'. A second record for category 0002 has the same account and type but a different key.
expectation: The (12345, 01, 0001) balance should be rewritten as 500.00 + 75.25 = 575.25. The (12345, 01, 0002) record should stay at 300.00. No new TCATBAL record should be created.

title: Existing category balance: negative amount drives the balance below zero
condition: Update branch with a signed negative DALYTRAN-AMT (-250.75) that is larger than the existing balance (100.00), so the sign has to be kept.
expectation: The (12345, 02, 0001) balance should be rewritten as 100.00 + (-250.75) = -150.75, with a negative sign in TRAN-CAT-BAL.

title: Two transactions on the same new key: first creates, second updates
condition: Both branches in one run: the first transaction for (12345, 01, 0003) finds no record and creates one. The second transaction must then find that record and take the update path.
expectation: The run should end with exactly one TCATBAL record for (12345, 01, 0003), with balance 40.00 + 60.01 = 100.01. There should be no duplicate-key write.

title: Rejected transaction does not touch the category balance
condition: Given precondition: validation fails because the account expired (ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE 2024-01-15 is before the original date 2024-01-16), so WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON is not 0 and the transaction is not posted.
expectation: The (12345, 01, 0001) TCATBAL record should stay at 500.00 and no record should be created. The transaction should go to the rejects output instead.

title: Positive amount posts to balance and cycle credit
condition: Transaction passes validation and DALYTRAN-AMT > 0, so the zero-or-positive branch runs
expectation: ACCT-CURR-BAL 1000.00 -> 1250.75; ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT 500.00 -> 750.75; ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT stays -200.00. The account record is rewritten.

title: Negative amount posts to balance and cycle debit (debit grows more negative)
condition: Transaction passes validation and DALYTRAN-AMT < 0, so the negative branch runs
expectation: ACCT-CURR-BAL 1000.00 -> 960.00; ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT -200.00 -> -240.00 (the amount is added still negative, not subtracted); ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT stays 500.00. The account record is rewritten.

title: Zero amount goes down the credit branch
condition: Boundary: DALYTRAN-AMT = 0.00, which counts as zero-or-positive
expectation: ACCT-CURR-BAL stays 1000.00, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT stays 500.00 (zero is added to it) and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT stays -200.00. The account record is still rewritten, so no field should change, including the sign encoding of the zero values.

title: Three transactions on one account: +0.01, -0.01 and +123.45
condition: Boundary amounts one cent either side of zero, plus updates adding up across several posted transactions on the same account
expectation: Starting from 0.00 on all three fields: ACCT-CURR-BAL = 0.01 - 0.01 + 123.45 = 123.45; ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT = 0.01 + 123.45 = 123.46; ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT = -0.01. Each posting rewrites the account and the next transaction reads the updated values.

title: Negative amount pushes the current balance below zero
condition: Negative branch where the sum is negative: the signed balance field has to hold a negative result
expectation: ACCT-CURR-BAL 100.00 -> -50.25 (stored with a negative sign); ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT 0.00 -> -150.25; ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT stays 100.00. The account record is rewritten.

title: Single account, single category: first group, account written at end of file
condition: Only the first-record branch of the control break runs (WS-FIRST-TIME 'Y' becomes 'N', no rewrite of an earlier account). The rate is not zero, so interest is calculated. The account is written back when end of file is reached.
expectation: There is no rewrite before the account is read. Interest is 1200.00*12.00/1200 = 12.00, and one interest transaction is written with card 4000000000000001. At end of file account 10000000001 is rewritten with ACCT-CURR-BAL 512.00 and with ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT set to 0.

title: Two accounts with two categories each: control break rewrites previous account and resets total
condition: The account ID changes partway through the file and WS-FIRST-TIME is 'N', so 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT runs for the previous account and WS-TOTAL-INT is reset. Records that do not change the account still go on to rate lookup.
expectation: Account 10000000011: 1000*12/1200 = 10.00 plus 600*24/1200 = 12.00, a total of 22.00. It is rewritten when account 10000000012 is first seen, with ACCT-CURR-BAL 1022.00 and cycle credit and debit 0. Account 10000000012: 2400*6/1200 = 12.00 plus 300*18/1200 = 4.50, a total of 16.50 and nothing carried over from account 11. It is rewritten at end of file with ACCT-CURR-BAL 2016.50 and cycle credit and debit 0. Interest transactions carry card 4000000000000011 or 4000000000000012 to match their account.

title: Zero-rate categories within a group contribute no interest
condition: Each record in one account group gets its own rate lookup. The first record (rate 0) and the last record (rate 0) skip the interest calculation. Only the middle record (rate 15.00) adds interest.
expectation: Only category 01/0002 gives interest: 1200*15/1200 = 15.00, so one interest transaction. Categories 01/0001 (5000.00) and 02/0001 (800.00) produce no transaction and add nothing. Account 10000000021 is rewritten at end of file with ACCT-CURR-BAL 7015.00 and cycle credit and debit 0.

title: Three single-category accounts, middle one zero rate: total reset between groups
condition: Two control breaks in a row. The middle account's only category has rate 0, so its interest total stays at the reset value of 0. Checks that WS-TOTAL-INT does not carry over from the first account into the second or third.
expectation: Account 10000000031: interest 12.00, rewritten at the first break with ACCT-CURR-BAL 112.00 and cycles 0. Account 10000000032: no interest transaction, rewritten at the second break with ACCT-CURR-BAL still 200.00 but cycle credit and debit set to 0. Account 10000000033: interest 600*12/1200 = 6.00, rewritten at end of file with ACCT-CURR-BAL 306.00 and cycles 0.

title: Negative category balance: interest total can be negative
condition: There are no control breaks after the first record. A negative category balance with a non-zero rate gives negative interest, which is added to the accumulated total along with positive interest from the other category.
expectation: The interest amounts are -1200*12/1200 = -12.00 and 300*24/1200 = 6.00, a total of -6.00. Account 10000000041 is rewritten at end of file with ACCT-CURR-BAL -906.00 and cycle credit and debit 0.

title: Account break adds interest from two categories to the first account; the last account is left unchanged
condition: Account 10000000001 has two category records, then account 10000000002 starts. This is the main branch: 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT runs on the change of account and it is not the first group. Account 10000000002 is the last group, so it runs into the end-of-file defect.
expectation: Account 10000000001: interest total = 1200.00*12.00/1200 + 600.00*18.00/1200 = 12.00 + 9.00 = 21.00. ACCT-CURR-BAL goes from 1000.00 to 1021.00, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT goes from 250.00 to 0 and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT goes from 400.00 to 0, and the record is rewritten. Account 10000000002 (the last group): its 8.00 of interest is calculated but not added. The record is not rewritten, so it keeps balance 2000.00, cycle credit 100.00 and cycle debit 50.00.

title: Zero interest total still clears the cycle credit and debit
condition: The disclosure rate is 0, so no interest is calculated and WS-TOTAL-INT stays 0. The account break still happens because a second account follows.
expectation: Account 20000000001: the balance stays 1500.00 (1500.00 + 0). ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT goes from 75.25 to 0 and ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT goes from 310.40 to 0, and the record is rewritten. Account 20000000002 is the last group and is not rewritten: it keeps 300.00, credit 20.00 and debit 30.00.

title: A file with a single account group never updates that account
condition: Only one account appears in TCATBAL. There is no account break, and the end-of-file stops the loop before the ELSE branch that would update the account can run.
expectation: Interest of 2400.00*12/1200 + 1200.00*24/1200 = 24.00 + 24.00 = 48.00 is calculated, and interest transactions may still be written. The account record is not rewritten: ACCT-CURR-BAL stays 3600.00, cycle credit stays 500.00 and cycle debit stays 900.00.

title: Three accounts: negative interest, fractional-cent interest and the skipped last account
condition: Three account groups give two account breaks. The first account has a negative category balance, so its interest is negative and is added to a negative current balance. The second has interest with fractions of a cent (333.33*10/1200 = 2.77775). The third is the last group.
expectation: Account 40000000001: interest = -600.00*10/1200 = -5.00. The balance goes from -100.00 to -105.00, cycle credit (600.00) and debit go to 0, and the record is rewritten. Account 40000000002: interest = 2.77775, truncated to 2.77 if the COMPUTE has no ROUNDED. The balance goes from 333.33 to 336.10, cycle debit goes from 333.33 to 0, and the record is rewritten. Account 40000000003 is the last group and is not rewritten: it keeps 900.00, credit 45.00 and debit 55.00.

title: Account group record found, so the DEFAULT record is not used
condition: The first read finds a match on group GOLD, type 01 and category 0001 (status 00) with a non-zero rate. A DEFAULT record with a different rate also exists for the same type and category.
expectation: The program uses the GOLD rate of 18.00 and never falls back to DEFAULT. Interest is calculated as 1200.00 * 18.00 / 1200 = 18.00 (not 24.00, which is the DEFAULT rate). One interest transaction is written for account 10000000001, and the account balance goes up by 18.00.

title: Fallback to DEFAULT when the category code does not match
condition: Group SILVER and type 01 exist, but only for category 0001. The balance is for category 0002, so the first read returns status 23. The fallback key DEFAULT + 01 + 0002 exists.
expectation: The program shows the 'DISCLOSURE GROUP RECORD MISSING' / 'TRY WITH DEFAULT GROUP CODE' messages and reads the DEFAULT record. Interest is calculated as 600.00 * 24.00 / 1200 = 12.00 (the SILVER 12.00 rate for category 0001 is not used). One interest transaction is written, and the account balance goes up by 12.00.

title: Zero rate on a matched record skips the balance; the smallest non-zero rate is used
condition: Boundary for the rate check. The first balance (type 01) matches a PROMO record with rate 0.00. The second balance (type 02) matches a PROMO record with rate 0.01. A DEFAULT record with rate 24.00 exists for type 01.
expectation: Balance 1: the record is found with status 00 and rate zero, so the program does not fall back to DEFAULT and skips the balance (no interest transaction). Balance 2: the rate 0.01 is not zero, so interest is 1200.00 * 0.01 / 1200 = 0.01 and one transaction is written. The account balance goes up by 0.01 in total.

title: Both the account group record and the DEFAULT record are missing, so the program abends
condition: The balance is for group BRONZE, type 03, category 0005. BRONZE and DEFAULT records exist only for category 0004, so the first read returns status 23 and the DEFAULT read also fails (status not 00).
expectation: The program falls back to DEFAULT, the DEFAULT read fails, and the program displays 'ERROR READING DEFAULT DISCLOSURE GROUP' and abends. No interest is posted for account 10000000004.

title: Positive balance, monthly interest truncated to 2 decimals
condition: The rate is not zero (18.99) and the balance is positive. The exact interest has a third decimal, so we can check that the result is truncated, not rounded.
expectation: Monthly interest = 1000.00 x 18.99 / 1200 = 15.825, truncated to 15.82 (not rounded to 15.83). One interest transaction for 15.82 is written for account 10000000001 / card 4000000000000001. The running total for the account is 15.82, so the account balance goes from 1000.00 to 1015.82.

title: Zero interest rate skips interest
condition: DIS-INT-RATE = 0 (the exact boundary of the not-zero check).
expectation: No monthly interest is computed and no interest transaction is written for this balance. The running total stays at 0, so the account balance stays at 2500.00.

title: Negative balance truncates toward zero
condition: The balance is negative and the rate is not zero. The exact interest is negative with a third decimal.
expectation: Monthly interest = -1000.00 x 18.99 / 1200 = -15.825, truncated toward zero to -15.82 (not -15.83). One interest transaction for -15.82 is written. The account balance goes from -1000.00 to -1015.82.

title: Running total adds up within an account and resets when the account changes
condition: Account 10000000004 has two category balances, both with non-zero rates. Then account 10000000005 has one. The running total must reset to 0 when the account ID changes.
expectation: Account 4: 1200.00 x 12.00 / 1200 = 12.00, and 333.33 x 24.00 / 1200 = 6.66664, truncated to 6.66. Two transactions are written and the total is 18.66, so the balance goes from 1533.33 to 1551.99. Account 5: 600.00 x 12.00 / 1200 = 6.00. One transaction is written. The total resets, so it is 6.00, not 24.66, and the balance goes from 600.00 to 606.00. Three transactions in all.

title: Tiny interest truncates to 0.00 but is still written; negative rate
condition: The first balance has a non-zero rate, but its interest truncates to 0.00. The second balance on the same account has a negative rate, which is still non-zero.
expectation: Category 1: 0.50 x 1.00 / 1200 = 0.000416, truncated to 0.00. The rate is not zero, so a transaction for 0.00 is still written. Category 2: 1000.00 x -6.00 / 1200 = -5.00, and a transaction for -5.00 is written. The account's total is -5.00, so the balance goes from 1000.50 to 995.50. Two transactions in all.

title: Single interest transaction: basic record layout
condition: One account with one category balance and a non-zero rate. This is the first interest transaction, so the sequence counter goes from 0 to 1.
expectation: One transaction is written. TRAN-ID='2022071800000001' (the PARM plus suffix 000001). TRAN-TYPE-CD='01', TRAN-CAT-CD=0005, TRAN-SOURCE='System'. TRAN-DESC='Int. for a/c 12345678901'. TRAN-AMT=10.00 (1000.00*12.00/1200). TRAN-MERCHANT-ID=0, and merchant name, city and zip are spaces. TRAN-CARD-NUM='4111111111111111'. TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS are equal and use the format YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000.

title: Leading zeros in description, and a zero-rate category takes no sequence number
condition: The account ID is small (7), so the description should keep leading zeros. There are three categories: the middle one has DIS-INT-RATE=0 and builds no transaction. The last amount has a fraction to check truncation.
expectation: Two transactions are written, with IDs 2022071800000001 and 2022071800000002. The zero-rate category does not increase the counter. TRAN-DESC='Int. for a/c 00000000007' on both. TRAN-AMT=37.50 (2500.00*18.00/1200) and 5.55 (333.33*19.99/1200=5.5527…, truncated). TRAN-CARD-NUM='4222222222222222'. Type, category and source are '01', 0005 and 'System'.

title: Sequence keeps counting across accounts; card number comes from each account's XREF
condition: Two accounts with three interest-bearing categories in total. This checks that the counter is not reset when the account changes and that each record gets its own account's card number.

title: Negative balance and an interest amount that truncates to zero
condition: One category has a negative balance, so the interest amount is negative. Another has a 0.01 balance with a non-zero rate, so the computed interest truncates to 0.00. The record should still be built because the rate is non-zero.
expectation: Two transactions are written. 2022071800000001 has TRAN-AMT=-30.00 (-1500.00*24/1200). 2022071800000002 has TRAN-AMT=0.00 (0.01*12/1200=0.0001, truncated). Both have description 'Int. for a/c 55555555555', card '6011000000005555', type '01', category 0005, source 'System', merchant ID 0 and blank merchant fields, and equal orig/proc timestamps.
